diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says 3Vo, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: Adafruit LPS3X board file: header JP3 pad 2 is on net 3.3V and the second silkscreen label (x=6.477, after VIN at 3.937) is 3Vo: 'x="6.477" y="4.191" size="1.016" layer="21" font="vector" ratio="14" align="center">3Vo</text>'; the second reading reordered the pins by function.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says GND, datasheet reading says 3Vo
diffs.evidence: Adafruit LPS3X board file: the third silkscreen label (x=9.017) is GND and JP3 pad 3 is on the GND net: 'x="9.017" y="0.889" size="1.016" layer="21" font="vector" ratio="14" align="center">GND</text>'.

diffs.diff: header pin 5: part says SDO, datasheet reading says SDI
diffs.evidence: Adafruit LPS3X board file: the fifth silkscreen label (x=14.097, between SCK at 11.557 and SDI at 16.51) is SDO, and JP3 pad 5 is on net SDO/ADR: 'x="14.097" y="0.889" size="1.016" layer="21" font="vector" ratio="14" align="center">SDO</text>'.

diffs.diff: header pin 6: part says SDA, datasheet reading says SDO
diffs.evidence: Adafruit LPS3X board file: the sixth silkscreen label (x=16.51) is SDI, the I2C data pin modelled as SDA, and JP3 pad 6 is on net SDI/SDA: 'x="16.51" y="4.064" size="1.016" layer="21" font="vector" ratio="14" align="center">SDI</text>'.

diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Adafruit pinout guide for this board family says the on-board regulator accepts 3 V minimum on VIN: 'we have included a voltage regulator on board that will take 3-5VDC and safely convert it down'.
